set.body:
Why
NumPy gains substantial throughput from out= and amortized iterator setup. Ravel already has selected Into kernels, but comparison, predicate, and repeated-shape workloads still force results or planning work that callers cannot safely reuse.

Scope
- Design typed compareInto and predicateInto surfaces, plus any missing scalar or unary Into operations justified by the court.
- Introduce prepared immutable traversal plans and explicit reusable workspaces only where repeated public calls prove setup or temporary allocation material.
- Keep schema, dtype, shape, ownership, alias, overlap, and output-layout choices explicit in types or validated construction.
- Prepared plans may cache semantic shape and stride analysis, never bind accidentally to mutable data identity.
- Define safe alias and overlap behavior; reject invalid output buffers before mutation.

Scala.js impact
Output and plan reuse should reduce typed-array allocation and garbage collection in Node and browsers. Implementations must avoid wrapper churn and must lower to the same direct typed-array loops as allocating calls. No API may expose JVM-only array assumptions.

Acceptance
- Repeated-call public benchmarks demonstrate amortized gain and bounded per-call allocation on JVM and full-linked Node.
- At least one-shot, repeated same-shape, buffer-reuse, broadcast, strided, and overlap cases are covered.
- Allocating convenience APIs delegate without changing C-order result contracts.
- Invalid dtype, shape, ownership, and alias combinations fail deterministically before partial writes.
- Targeted repeated workloads improve at least 1.20x or the proposed abstraction is rejected with a receipt.
- JVM and Scala.js laws, signatures, source compatibility checks, and fullLink pass.
set.title: Add reusable outputs and prepared execution plans
